content:
Use the python tool to read this CSV and create a PNG line chart.
Requirements:
- Plot monthly average temperature (Jan-Dec only; ignore Annual Mean)
- Include x/y axes and month labels
- Read the CSV, create the chart, and save it in a single Python execution; do not make preliminary inspection calls
- Save exactly one PNG file and close the figure with plt.close()
- Do not display the figure inline
- Include exactly one download link to the saved PNG in your final response

CSV:
Month,Average Temperature (°C),Deviation from 1991-2020 Norm (°C)
January,0.0,+1.5
February,1.3,+1.7
March,4.1,+1.5
April,8.2,+1.9
May,10.3,-0.2
June,17.6,+3.8
July,15.4,-0.3
August,16.4,+1.2
September,11.9,+0.5
October,7.2,-0.2
November,2.3,+0.1
December,1.3,+2.0
Annual Mean,8.0,+1.1

input.code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, io, os, textwrap
csv_text = """Month,Average Temperature (°C),Deviation from 1991-2020 Norm (°C)
January,0.0,+1.5
February,1.3,+1.7
March,4.1,+1.5
April,8.2,+1.9
May,10.3,-0.2
June,17.6,+3.8
July,15.4,-0.3
August,16.4,+1.2
September,11.9,+0.5
October,7.2,-0.2
November,2.3,+0.1
December,1.3,+2.0
Annual Mean,8.0,+1.1
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_text))
df = df[df['Month'] != 'Annual Mean']
month_order = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"]
df['Month'] = pd.Categorical(df['Month'], categories=month_order, ordered=True)
df = df.sort_values('Month')
x = df['Month'].astype(str)
y = df['Average Temperature (°C)']
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,5))
ax.plot(x, y, marker='o', linewidth=2)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Average Temperature (°C)')
ax.set_title('Monthly Average Temperature (Jan–Dec)')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(x)))
ax.set_xticklabels(x, rotation=0)
ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.4)
out_path = "/mnt/data/monthly_avg_temperature.png"
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(out_path, dpi=200)
plt.close(fig)
out_path
